0022600005.text: Both the Los Angeles Lakers and Golden State Warriors open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Lakers hosting. The Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton (calf), while the Warriors are without Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. In the 2025-26 season series the Lakers won 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 119-103 Lakers win in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
